reason: A client-side DSH interface enhancement that adds a vertical rail for previewing and jumping to user messages in long conversations; the README states it makes no network requests or API calls.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH 对话框添加消息导航轨道，可悬停预览用户消息并点击跳转到对应位置。
summaries.en: Adds a message navigation rail to the DSH dialog for previewing user messages on hover and jumping to their locations.

capabilities: Adds a client-side conversation navigation rail
Reads and displays user-sent message text locally for hover previews
Scrolls the conversation to the selected user message
Adapts its position and appearance to sidebar size and light or dark themes
